mapper.sql: (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM purchase_item i WHERE i.product_id=p.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sale_item s WHERE s.product_id=p.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stocktake_item t WHERE t.product_id=p.id) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement m WHERE m.product_id=p.id))

CAST(p.id AS CHAR) id,p.code,p.barcode,p.name,CAST(p.category_id AS CHAR) category_id,c.name category_name,p.specification,p.unit,p.reference_cost,p.sale_price,p.image_path,p.manages_expiry,p.shelf_life_days,p.near_expiry_days,p.stock_lower_limit,p.can_purchase,p.can_sell,p.enabled,p.stock_qty, referenced,p.remark,p.created_at

sql.if: AND (CONVERT(p.code USING utf8mb4) LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR p.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR CONVERT(p.barcode USING utf8mb4)=#{keyword})

mapper.select: SELECT FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.id=#{id}
SELECT FROM product p WHERE p.id=#{id}

SELECT CAST(p.id AS CHAR) id,p.code,p.barcode,p.name,CAST(p.category_id AS CHAR) category_id,c.name category_name,p.specification,p.unit,p.reference_cost,p.manages_expiry,p.shelf_life_days,p.image_path,(p.frozen_stocktake_id IS NOT NULL) frozen FROM product p JOIN category c ON c.id=p.category_id WHERE p.enabled=1 AND p.can_purchase=1 ORDER BY p.created_at DESC,p.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.enabled=1 AND p.can_purchase=1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM product p WHERE p.enabled=1 AND p.can_sell=1
